notes:
What's new in Vekrun 0.2.8

• Your plan, on the AI Factory screen: if your project keeps tickets in Markdown (## P1-T1: …), Vekrun reads them by itself and lists what's next, what's waiting on what, and a Start button that runs the ticket held to its Acceptance. They're on your Board too.
• Team skills at a glance: a pill beside the composer shows your project's skills and which ones load for what you're typing.
• Project understanding, redesigned: real step-by-step progress, a clear "understood" state, and your connected Obsidian vaults listed with their note counts. Adding a vault now confirms what was read.

Also since 0.2.6
• Tool versions (Agents): see when Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, the GitHub CLI, Lima or Ollama fall behind, and update in one click. Copies Vekrun installed update themselves.
• Production monitoring keeps your open errors however old, and the search and filters stay pinned while you scroll.
• Failed AI Factory runs can be run again or removed from the list.
